latHint: Think a gloomy poem that keeps saying 'Nevermore.'
pivHint: A ROOK is the castle in chess - but it is also a black bird, cousin of the crow and the ______.
winText: Nevermore lost. ROOK was the pivot - a chess castle to a black bird, the RAVEN.
lossText: RAVEN - a big black bird of the crow family. ROOK was the pivot: the chess ROOK shares its name with a ROOK bird, kin to the RAVEN.
